name: Diseased Fighter (Human Fighter 4)
body:
Diseased Fighter
CR 1

This character’s CR has been reduced to account for the fact that he is suffering from a crippling disease, lacks equipment, and is quite insane. He will attack the PC which is the focus of his hatred without any regard for his own life or safety, including provoking any number of attacks of opportunity.

XP 400
Male human fighter 4
CN Medium humanoid
Init -3; Senses Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 7, touch 7, flat-footed 7 (-3 Dex)
hp 22 (4d10-4)
Fort +2, Ref -2, Will +2 (+3 vs. fear)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +8 (1d3+4)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 13 (currently 4), Con 14 (currently 6), Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +4; CMB +8; CMD 15
Feats Diehard, Endurance, Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (longsword)
Skills Climb +11, Intimidate +7
Languages Common, +1 additional
